facts.text: Historical formulas, thresholds, budgets, recency calculations, rollout durations, and processing defaults are illustrative or conflicting and must not be treated as validated algorithms, acceptance criteria, current estimates, or current defaults; current local-first owner instructions take precedence. | When: November 6, 2026 | Involving: memoryos project | The report contains conflicting cloud-processing and local-speech-recognition defaults and requires mathematical review before reuse.

Project memoryos aims to extend a working local app with owner-selected integrations, but the first connector and exact implementation order remain undecided. Candidate integrations include chat-export formats, PDF/DOCX and scanned-document reading, Obsidian, email/calendar providers, optional external AI, and later device sync. | When: November 6, 2026 | Involving: Project owner | Authoritative project plan; selection is still open.

Arabic and English are required languages for memoryos; support for other languages is part of the requested vision, but the exact language list remains open. Iraqi Arabic, mixed Arabic/English, names, nicknames, sarcasm, dates, and Arabic right-to-left text are proposed evaluation cases, with no model performance established as acceptable. | When: November 6, 2026 | Involving: memoryos | Language requirements and evaluation status are explicitly documented, while performance is unverified.

The current target device is the owner's iPhone 15 Pro Max; everyday capture, memory, and AI processing should work on the phone, and a Mac must not be required. Optional external services require a separate choice. | When: November 6, 2026 | Involving: user | This is a confirmed product constraint for everyday use.

The project plans to evaluate llama.cpp for text, WhisperKit or whisper.cpp for speech, and small multilingual models such as Qwen3-1.7B (P18). No component has been selected and no benchmark exists yet; this entry is an evaluation plan, not a verified result. | When: November 6, 2026 | To assess candidate native AI components for text and speech processing.

The planned first demonstration is an end-to-end phone acceptance path: download model files, enable airplane mode, record a short Arabic/English note, save audio and editable text, link it to a fictional person and project, answer a known question with supporting-source access, correct a mistaken detail and verify the correction, export the record or transcript, then interrupt and resume an import without duplicates or lost captures. | When: Proposed on November 6, 2026; no step has passed in the app | Involving: Project owner and implementation agent | This is a proposed acceptance path, not proof of implementation or testing; numeric quality and performance targets still require review after measurement.

Local AI is central to the current request, superseding the previous sequencing in which local models were a later optional edition. | When: November 6, 2026 | Involving: memoryos project | The current request prioritizes local, phone-first processing.

The proposed record-protection design should preserve sources, passages, people, projects, ideas, dated claims, owner corrections, interpretations, rules, and reminder proposals, with source IDs, links, edits, deletion, attachments, backup/restore, and protected keys designed together. SQLite is only a candidate; the final database, encryption, schema, and search index remain open. | When: Planned; no implementation date committed | Information and its history must be protected before automation is added.
